title: make_small_biz/make_campus KeyError on the DARK palette — 5.11 keys added to LIGHT only
evidence: diff (LIGHT additions): "+    \"b_small_biz\": \"#9C8C6C\", \"b_small_biz_roof\": \"#6E6148\",  # 5.11 office (warm stone)" / "+    \"b_campus\": \"#A8503C\", \"b_campus_roof\": \"#6E3026\", \"b_campus_quad\": \"#A8C878\",  # 5.11 campus (brick + quad)" — DARK (pp_lib.py:66, read in worktree): "    \"b_gaming\": \"#322a5a\", \"b_finance\": \"#3a3320\", \"b_cdn\": \"#2a3240\",  # extra terminal bodies" (DARK's only b_* line — no 5.11 keys). New makers (read in worktree): "    body_m = emissive_mat(name + \"_body\", pal[\"b_small_biz\"], pal[\"body_str\"])" and "    body_m = emissive_mat(name + \"_body\", pal[\"b_campus\"], pal[\"body_str\"])")
detail: New makers require b_small_biz*/b_campus* palette keys, added only to LIGHT. DARK keeps every other terminal body key, so calling either maker with DARK (the header's documented palette pair) raises KeyError mid-build — no guard.
recommended_fix: Mirror the five keys into DARK (dark-register equivalents), or add a fail-fast key check at the top of make_small_biz/make_campus listing the required pal keys.

title: content_bbox() emits a degenerate negative bbox for a fully-transparent render; main() writes it unchecked
evidence: tools/gen_sprites.py (read in worktree): "    minx, miny, maxx, maxy = w, h, -1, -1" ... "    top_y = h - (miny + (maxy - miny + 1))  # bottom-up -> top-down flip" / "    return [minx, top_y, maxx - minx + 1, maxy - miny + 1]" — consumed unchecked in main(): "        boxes[n] = content_bbox(os.path.join(OUT, n + \".png\"))" — no maxx<0 / range guard anywhere between them.
detail: A fully-transparent render (mis-aimed camera/pad for either new sprite) leaves maxx=-1, minx=w, so bbox becomes [256,256,-256,-256]; main() json.dumps it unchecked. sprites_parse_boxes then rejects the entire 11-sprite sheet — all-sprite primitive fallback, no generator-side error.
recommended_fix: After the pixel scan, guard: if maxx < 0: raise SystemExit('empty render ' + path); optionally assert x,w,h in range and x+w<=256 before json.dump.
